fixtures.application:
You maintain a house writing-voice profile for an engineering team's internal notes. The profile ships inside a public skill package, and the release pipeline runs a leak check that fails the build whenever a profile entry shares a verbatim run of eight or more words with a source document.

Two new primary docs from the author, both in the notes format:

--- rebalancer-notes.md ---

Quick note before standup: the shard rebalancer only misbehaves when the deploy train is already on fire, so IIUC paging the on-call before the rollout finishes is how we keep losing Tuesdays. The queue never lies but the dashboard always does; I stopped trusting the red row after Project Nightjar's launch. Mara agrees the rollback script needs a dry-run mode. I think on-call rotations should be voluntary — nobody writes good pages at 3am on a schedule.

--- exporter-notes.md ---

tl;dr: shipped the invoice-pdf exporter retry patch (PR #4471) and, same as last week, the queue never lies but the dashboard always does — watch the depth chart, not the latency panel. IIUC the retry storm came from our own timeout value, not from upstream. No chart survives contact with the on-call log; the more polished the dashboard, the less I believe it. On-call rotations should stay voluntary if we want pages anyone actually reads.
